meta.rules: Only genuine concurrency/state/contract bugs; no style, speculation, or refactors.

findings.title: Partial shard spawn commits earlier shards and orphans a session
trigger: swarm{action:'add', name:'w', n:3, owned_globs:['src/**']}
shard 1 claims src/**; shard 2 conflicts with live shard 1
findings.observable: Tool returns ok:false, but w-1 stays working with the lock, w-2 is killed, both sessions exist; sess_2 orphaned. Retry fails 'w-1 already exists'. Deterministic for n>1 + owned_globs.

findings.title: Waiter resolution and wake prompt can double-deliver one post
trigger: member parks swarm_wait{since:head}
two posts mention it before the parked tool continuation runs (same event-loop turn)
findings.observable: swarm_wait returns posts [#2] while a queued wake prompt contains [#2,#3]; post #2 delivered twice.

findings.title: Spawn wake precedes the opening prompt; excludeMemberIds is unused
trigger: any swarm{action:'add'}
findings.observable: New session receives two queued prompts: board wake-up first, role/brief opening prompt second; worker can act before it has rules.

findings.title: Concurrent swarm_wait overwrites the waiter; first call hangs
trigger: same member session issues two swarm_wait calls in parallel
findings.observable: Second waiter replaces the first; only the second resolves; the first never settles until abort/timeout. DB wait state overwritten too.

findings.title: Cross-channel @mention/@all routing inconsistent and leaks text
trigger: @w subscribed only to #main parks swarm_wait{mentions_only:true}
coordinator posts '@w look' or '@all' into #dev
findings.observable: Parked @w is never woken; the same post wakes an unparked @w and the prompt contains the full #dev text it cannot read.

findings.title: Two running swarms coexist; status and board/RPC disagree
trigger: session A swarm add -> swarm A running
session B in the same workspace swarm add -> swarm B running
findings.observable: 2 active swarms; session A status returns A, B returns B, while /api/swarm, getBoardInfo, getSwarmSnapshot return activeSwarms[0]. Monitor handles both; two unrelated boards live.

findings.title: Same-PID reload treated as stale; live swarm destroyed and sessions unfenced
trigger: start a swarm
reload the plugin in the same host process (owner_pid == currentPid)
findings.observable: Healthy swarm becomes interrupted, all members killed, locks deleted, child sessions stay alive. Old verifier flips deny->allow while no swarm active; then denied as unregistered once a new swarm starts. test/db-and-recovery.test.ts:35-42 codifies it.

findings.title: Board serves only the oldest 500 posts; newest unreachable
trigger: swarm reaches 501+ posts
open the board or call the RPC
findings.observable: Response {head:505, messages:500, firstSeq:1, lastSeq:500}; posts 501+ never served; feed freezes at #500 while tab count shows head; graph edges/member counts truncated. test/board-server.test.ts:111-144 asserts it.

findings.title: unchanged fast path omits member; UI clears identity each poll
trigger: leave the board idle until a poll returns unchanged (1.5 s interval)
findings.observable: state.me becomes null; '(you)' marker and unread 'New' divider/highlight disappear despite unread posts.

findings.title: read_board advances one global cursor past unread other-channel posts
trigger: member of main+dev; dev post seq 1, main post seq 2
call read_board({channel:'main'})
findings.observable: Cursor advances to 2; later reads with default since skip the dev post permanently; wake fallback also skips it. Lost post with no gap signal.

findings.title: UI consumes snap.unseen, which the server never emits
trigger: non-main channel exists
unsubscribed member opens the board
a post lands in that channel
findings.observable: state.unseen is always null, so a post the member cannot read still counts toward its 'New' divider/highlight.

verified_clean.evidence: 470,935 glob pairs fuzzed -> 0 false negatives; BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes claims
all cursor writes are MAX-only; no regression path
killed-terminal at DB level; paused_quota persists across reopen
model.list {location,data}, permission.source, tool result shapes match; activity label has pendingCalls fallback
